abyssorigins.origin.human.name: Human
abyssorigins.origin.human.description: An ordinary soul in an extraordinary world. No gift of blood or flame — only grit, adaptability and the will to master any craft the Abyss offers.
abyssorigins.origin.human.trait.1: +25% class XP and faster class abilities
abyssorigins.origin.human.trait.2: No sunlight, water or darkness weaknesses
abyssorigins.origin.human.trait.3: No supernatural resource or innate magic
abyssorigins.origin.vampire.name: Vampire
abyssorigins.origin.vampire.description: An immortal creature of the night. Blood is your sustenance; sunlight your doom. Master the darkness and prey upon the living.
abyssorigins.origin.vampire.trait.2: Night vision and +15% speed in darkness
abyssorigins.origin.vampire.trait.4: Cannot eat — must feed on blood
abyssorigins.origin.demon.name: Demon
abyssorigins.origin.demon.description: Born of brimstone in the deepest pits of the Abyss. Fire is your cradle and violence your fuel — every blow feeds your Wrath, and Wrath is power.
abyssorigins.origin.demon.trait.1: Immune to fire and lava; +10% max health
abyssorigins.origin.demon.trait.2: Wrath builds in combat and empowers your strikes
abyssorigins.origin.seraph.name: Seraph
abyssorigins.origin.seraph.description: A fragment of the celestial choir that fell into the Abyss, still burning with light. Radiance gathers beneath the open sky — the deep earth smothers it.
abyssorigins.origin.seraph.trait.1: Light as a feather: no fall damage, 15% lower gravity
abyssorigins.origin.seraph.trait.4: Weakened deep underground, away from the sky
abyssorigins.origin.voidborn.name: Voidborn
abyssorigins.origin.voidborn.description: Something that crawled up from beneath the bottom of the world. Your body is barely anchored to reality — you step through space itself, and the void answers your call.
abyssorigins.origin.voidborn.trait.1: Blink through space and crush foes with gravity
abyssorigins.origin.voidborn.trait.2: Endermen ignore your gaze; immune to Levitation
abyssorigins.origin.voidborn.trait.3: -10% max health; all healing reduced by 25%
abyssorigins.origin.shade.name: Shade
abyssorigins.origin.shade.description: A living silhouette woven from the dark between stars. Shadows feed you Umbra and hide you from every eye — but true light burns away your strength.
abyssorigins.origin.shade.trait.2: Hard to notice in darkness; deadly ambushes
abyssorigins.origin.shade.trait.3: -10% max health; weakened in direct sunlight
Push beyond your limits: Haste II and Strength I for 8 seconds.
abyssorigins.ability.human_second_wind.d: Recover 30% of your max health, purge every harmful effect and gain Absorption I for 10 seconds.
abyssorigins.ability.vampire_blood_drain: Bite the nearest blood-bearing creature within 3 blocks — animals, villagers or monsters: 3 damage, heal 1 heart, +15 Blood. Costs nothing if none is in reach.
abyssorigins.ability.vampire_bat_form.de: Unfurl great bat wings and take flight for 15s. Press again to fold them early. Costs 25 Blood.
abyssorigins.ability.demon_hellfire_nova: Erupt in hellfire: 6 damage to enemies within 5 blocks, igniting them and hurling them back. Costs 30 Wrath.
abyssorigins.ability.demon_infernal_char: Dash forward in a trail of flame, dealing 4 damage and igniting every enemy you pass through. Costs 20 Wrath.
abyssorigins.ability.seraph_wings.name: Ascendant Wings
abyssorigins.ability.seraph_wings.desc: Launch skyward on wings of light and glide for 8 seconds with Slow Falling. Costs 25 Radiance.
abyssorigins.ability.seraph_divine_light: A burst of holy light: allies within 8 blocks heal 3 hearts and become Sanctified for 6s; undead take 8 damage and burn. Costs 40 Radiance.
abyssorigins.ability.void_step.name: Void Step
abyssorigins.ability.void_step.desc: Teleport up to 16 blocks to where you are looking. Costs 15 Essence.
Tear open a rift where you look. For 3s it drags enemies within 7 blocks inward, then implodes for 8 damage and Sundered II. Costs 45 Essence.
abyssorigins.ability.shade_meld.name: Shadow Meld
abyssorigins.ability.shade_meld.desc: Melt into shadow for 8s: Invisibility, Speed, and hunters lose your trail. Your next melee strike breaks the meld for double damage and blinds. Costs 30 Umbra.
Shadow tendrils erupt beneath every enemy within 6 blocks: 4 damage and Stunned for 2 seconds. Costs 35 Umbra.
abyssorigins.ability.occult_vision.name: Occult Vision
abyssorigins.ability.occult_vision.desc: For 30s, see the auras of all players within 48 blocks through walls, coloured by origin. Only YOU see them. Press again to end.
abyssorigins.ability.occult_hexbolt.name: Hexbolt
abyssorigins.ability.occult_hexbolt.desc: Hurl a curse at the creature you are looking at: 5 magic damage and Hexed (+15% damage taken) for 6 seconds.
abyssorigins.ability.warrior_war_cry.des: Strength I and Resistance I for 8s. Allies within 8 blocks gain Strength; enemies within 6 are Weakened.
abyssorigins.ability.warrior_whirlwind.d: Spin, striking every enemy within 3.5 blocks for 120% of your attack damage and knocking them back.
abyssorigins.ability.assassin_shadowstep: Teleport behind the creature you are looking at (12 blocks). Your next strike within 2s is a guaranteed backstab.
abyssorigins.ability.assassin_venom_edge: Coat your blade for 10s: melee hits inflict Poison II and Bleeding.
abyssorigins.ability.guardian_shield_bas: Slam everything in front of you: 5 damage, heavy knockback and Stunned for 1.5 seconds.
abyssorigins.ability.guardian_aegis.name: Aegis
abyssorigins.ability.guardian_aegis.desc: Raise a golden dome for 6s: allies within 6 blocks take 40% less damage, and nearby monsters are taunted to attack you.
abyssorigins.ability.ranger_hunters_mark: Mark the creature you are looking at (48 blocks) for 12s: it takes +25% projectile damage and is outlined for you alone.
abyssorigins.ability.ranger_volley.name: Volley
abyssorigins.ability.ranger_volley.desc: Loose a fan of 5 spectral arrows.
abyssorigins.passive.human_regen.name: Well-Fed Recovery
abyssorigins.passive.human_regen.desc: Regeneration I pulses every 5s while your hunger is 14 or higher (10 with Endurance).
abyssorigins.passive.human_resilience.de: Gain Resistance I while at 4 hearts or fewer (5 with Calloused Hide).
abyssorigins.passive.human_ingenuity.des: Humans learn any craft quickly: +25% class XP and class ability cooldowns reduced by 10%.
abyssorigins.passive.vampire_hunger.name: Blood Dependency
abyssorigins.passive.vampire_hunger.desc: You cannot eat mortal food; Human Hearts and blood are your sustenance. Your hunger mirrors your blood.
abyssorigins.passive.vampire_sun.name: Sun Vulnerability
abyssorigins.passive.vampire_sun.desc: You burn in direct sunlight. Only an Umbrella or the Daywalker skill can protect you.
abyssorigins.passive.vampire_night.name: Creature of the Night
abyssorigins.passive.vampire_night.desc: Permanent night vision. +15% movement speed at night or in darkness.
abyssorigins.passive.blood_drain_gaze.de: Crouch and stare at a living creature for 5 seconds to lock on and drain its blood.
abyssorigins.passive.demon_hellborn.name: Hellborn Hide
abyssorigins.passive.demon_hellborn.desc: Fire and lava cannot harm you.
abyssorigins.passive.demon_wrath.name: Smoldering Wrath
abyssorigins.passive.demon_wrath.desc: Gain Wrath when you deal (+6) or take (+4) damage; it fades by 1 per second. Above 50 Wrath your melee hits set targets ablaze.
abyssorigins.passive.demon_nether_native: Gain Strength I while in the Nether.
abyssorigins.passive.demon_doused.name: Doused
abyssorigins.passive.demon_doused.desc: Rain and water inflict Weakness I; being submerged burns 1 health every 2 seconds.
abyssorigins.passive.seraph_feathered.de: You never take fall damage. Hold sneak while falling to drift slowly.
abyssorigins.passive.seraph_sunlit_grace: Beneath the open sky, Radiance regenerates (2/s by day, 0.6/s by night).
abyssorigins.passive.seraph_holy_bane.de: You deal 25% more damage to undead.
abyssorigins.passive.seraph_earthbound.d: Below Y=50 with no sky above you, you suffer Weakness I.
abyssorigins.passive.void_entropic_touch: Melee hits Sunder the target (-2 armor) for 4 seconds.
abyssorigins.passive.void_unanchored.des: Endermen ignore your gaze and Levitation cannot take hold of you. Essence flows faster in the End or below Y=0.
abyssorigins.passive.void_hollow_form.de: Your void-touched body heals 25% less from every source.
In darkness, creatures notice you from half the usual distance. Umbra gathers in darkness and fades in bright light.
abyssorigins.passive.shade_light_bane.de: In direct sunlight you suffer Weakness I.
abyssorigins.passive.occultist_dark_sens: Your senses extend beyond normal perception. Permanent night vision.
Occult Vision outlines creatures even through invisibility — no Shade or Vampire can hide from you.
abyssorigins.passive.warrior_momentum.de: Each melee hit within 3s of the last adds +5% damage, stacking up to 5 times.
abyssorigins.passive.warrior_battle_hard: +10% melee damage while wielding a sword or axe.
abyssorigins.passive.assassin_backstab.d: Melee hits from behind deal +50% damage.
abyssorigins.passive.guardian_bulwark.de: Blocking an attack with a shield grants Resistance I for 2 seconds.
abyssorigins.passive.ranger_hunters_inst: Projectile hits deal +2% damage per block beyond 10 (up to +30%).

abyssorigins.skill.human_tough_skin.name: Calloused Hide
abyssorigins.skill.human_tough_skin.desc: +2 armor. Survival Instinct triggers at 5 hearts instead of 4.
abyssorigins.skill.human_iron_will.name: Iron Will
abyssorigins.skill.human_iron_will.desc: +2 max hearts. Second Wind also grants Resistance I for 6 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.human_quick_learner.d: +15% origin and class XP from every source.
abyssorigins.skill.human_fighter.name: Fighter
abyssorigins.skill.human_fighter.desc: +1 melee damage. Adaptability also grants Speed I.
abyssorigins.skill.human_tactician.name: Tactician
abyssorigins.skill.human_tactician.desc: Class ability cooldowns reduced by a further 15%.
abyssorigins.skill.human_endurance.name: Endurance
abyssorigins.skill.human_endurance.desc: +3 max hearts. Well-Fed Recovery triggers at 10 hunger instead of 14.
abyssorigins.skill.human_swift.name: Swift
abyssorigins.skill.human_swift.desc: +10% movement speed. Falling below half health grants Speed II for 3 seconds (6s cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.human_rallying_cry.de: Adaptability also grants Strength I and Regeneration I to allies within 8 blocks.
abyssorigins.skill.human_last_stand.name: Last Stand
abyssorigins.skill.human_unbroken.name: Unbroken
abyssorigins.skill.human_unbroken.desc: Once every 5 minutes, a killing blow leaves you at 1 health with Resistance IV and Regeneration II instead.
abyssorigins.skill.human_paragon.name: Paragon
abyssorigins.skill.human_paragon.desc: +2 max hearts and +2 armor toughness. Second Wind's cooldown is halved.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_vitality.name: Vampiric Vitality
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_vitality.desc: +2 max hearts. Blood Drain heals an extra heart.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_agility.name: Predator's Grace
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_hunger.name: Insatiable Hunger
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_fangs.name: Razor Fangs
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_fangs.desc: +10% damage. Melee hits cause Bleeding for 3 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_resilience.name: Undead Resilience
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_resilience.desc: +2 armor and +1 max heart. Immune to Poison.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_swiftness.name: Bat's Swiftness
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_charm.name: Mesmerize
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_charm.desc: Blood Gaze locks on in half the time, and its victims are slowed harder.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_senses.name: Predator Senses
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_senses.desc: While crouching, sense every blood-bearing creature within 20 blocks through walls. Only you can see them.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_blood_frenzy.des: +25% damage, -2 armor. Below half health gain Strength I (Strength II below a quarter).
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_blood_drain_skil: +8% damage. Melee hits against blooded foes heal you for 10% of the damage dealt.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_shadow_stalker.d: +15% damage. Melee hits while invisible deal +50% damage.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_shadow_cloak.des: +5% speed. Become invisible while standing in low light.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_immortal_flesh.d: +5 max hearts, +20% knockback resistance. A killing blow instead consumes 50 Blood (2 min cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_rapid_regen.name: Rapid Regeneration
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_rapid_regen.desc: Blood drains 25% slower. Every 4s, convert 2 Blood into 1 heart while above 30 Blood.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_night_hunter.des: At night or in darkness, gain Strength I, Speed I and Resistance I.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_bat_mastery.name: Bat Transformation
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_bat_mastery.desc: Bat Form lasts twice as long. Origin ability cooldowns -10%.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_blood_lord.name: Blood Lord
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_blood_lord.desc: +20% damage, +15% attack speed. Blooded kills burst, dealing 4 damage and Bleeding to enemies within 4 blocks.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_crimson_tide.des: +12% damage. Blood Drain bites every enemy within 4.5 blocks.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_shadow_master.de: +18% damage. Melee hits while invisible blind and weaken the target for 3 seconds.
+10% damage, +2 max hearts, +8% speed. Every kill grants Speed I and Strength I for 5 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_ancient_one.name: Ancient One
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_ancient_one.desc: +4 max hearts, +4 armor, +2 armor toughness. Sunlight burns for half damage.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_specialist_assas: +40% damage, -4 armor, -2 max hearts. Melee hits execute non-boss creatures below 15% health; players take double.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_mist_form.name: Mist Form Mastery
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_mist_form.desc: +10% speed, origin cooldowns -20%. A blow that would drop you below 30% health turns you to mist instead (60s cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_synergy_bloodsha: +10% damage. While invisible, melee hits steal 20% of damage as health and restore 5 Blood.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_forbidden_bloodp: +35% damage, +25% melee lifesteal. Sunlight burns three times as hard.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_nosferatu.name: Nosferatu
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_nosferatu.desc: +15% damage, +3 max hearts, +10% speed. Origin cooldowns -25% and Bat Form costs no Blood.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_ascended_progeni: +20% damage, +4 max hearts. At night, regenerate 1 Blood every 3 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_kindling.name: Kindling
abyssorigins.skill.demon_kindling.desc: Gain 25% more Wrath from all sources.
+2 armor. Creatures that strike you in melee catch fire for 3 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_hellfire_master: Hellfire Nova reaches 7 blocks and inflicts Weakness for 4 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
abyssorigins.skill.demon_cinder_dash.des: Infernal Charge travels 50% farther and costs only 10 Wrath.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_tempered.name: Tempered
abyssorigins.skill.demon_tempered.desc: You are no longer affected by Doused.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_infernal_resili: +2 max hearts. Above 75 Wrath, gain Resistance I.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_soul_brand.name: Soul Brand
abyssorigins.skill.demon_soul_brand.desc: Melee hits on burning targets deal +2 damage and inflict Wither for 3 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_ember_heart.des: When your Wrath peaks (95+), a free Hellfire Nova erupts at 75% power (30s cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.demon_archfiend.name: Archfiend
abyssorigins.skill.demon_archfiend.desc: +2 max hearts. Hellfire Nova's cooldown is halved. Above 50 Wrath, a burning aura scorches enemies within 2.5 blocks.
+30% damage. Wrath never fades — but Doused burns for 3 damage instead of 1.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_halo.name: Halo
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_wingspan.name: Wingspan
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_wingspan.desc: Ascendant Wings launch higher and last 12 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_smite.name: Smite
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_smite.desc: Melee hits against undead deal +3 damage and ignite them.
Divine Light heals 2 extra hearts and purges harmful effects from allies.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_skyward.name: Skyward Soul
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_skyward.desc: Earthbound Burden only applies below Y=0.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_judgement.name: Judgement
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_judgement.desc: Divine Light also deals 4 damage to every hostile creature and blinds them for 3 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_aegis.name: Guardian Halo
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_aegis.desc: +2 armor. When a blow drops you below 30% health, become Sanctified for 6 seconds (60s cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_zephyr.name: Zephyr
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_zephyr.desc: While Ascendant Wings is active, sprint mid-air to glide forward swiftly.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_wrath_of_heave: Falling critical strikes call down a lance of light for +4 damage (3s cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_beacon.name: Beacon of Dawn
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_beacon.desc: Every 5s while above 50 Radiance, spend 1 Radiance to grant Regeneration I to allies within 6 blocks.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_ascension.name: Archangel
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_ascension.desc: +2 max hearts. Ascendant Wings grants true flight, and Divine Light's cooldown is halved.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_fallen_grace.d: +30% damage. Radiance also gathers in darkness and Earthbound Burden is lifted — but Holy Bane is lost and Divine Light heals half as much.
abyssorigins.skill.void_attunement.name: Attunement
abyssorigins.skill.void_phase_skin.name: Phase Skin
abyssorigins.skill.void_phase_skin.desc: 15% chance for melee attacks to pass harmlessly through you.
abyssorigins.skill.void_blink_mastery.de: Void Step reaches 24 blocks and its cooldown is 3 seconds shorter.
abyssorigins.skill.void_erosion_deep.des: Entropic Touch stacks: each hit worsens Sundered, up to level III (-6 armor).
abyssorigins.skill.void_hunger.name: Void Hunger
abyssorigins.skill.void_hunger.desc: Killing a Sundered creature restores 10 Essence.
abyssorigins.skill.void_unseen_step.name: Unseen Step
abyssorigins.skill.void_unseen_step.desc: Void Step grants 3s of Invisibility, and your next melee hit within 3s deals +50% damage.
abyssorigins.skill.void_singularity.name: Singularity
abyssorigins.skill.void_singularity.desc: Rift Collapse pulls from 10 blocks and implodes for +4 damage.
abyssorigins.skill.void_null_ward.name: Null Ward
abyssorigins.skill.void_null_ward.desc: +2 max hearts. Immune to Wither, Darkness and Blindness.
abyssorigins.skill.void_echo.name: Echo
abyssorigins.skill.void_echo.desc: Void Step leaves an echo at your departure point that detonates after 1 second for 5 damage.
abyssorigins.skill.void_entropy_field.de: Enemies within 4 blocks are constantly slowed and Sundered.
abyssorigins.skill.void_abyss_walker.des: +2 max hearts. Void Step costs no Essence, its cooldown is halved, and you never take fall damage.
abyssorigins.skill.void_heart_of_abyss.d: Rift Collapse lasts twice as long and implodes for double damage — but Hollow Form halves all your healing.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_deep_shadows.de: Umbra gathers 50% faster, and in slightly brighter places.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_ambush.name: Ambush
abyssorigins.skill.shade_ambush.desc: Strikes that break Shadow Meld deal x2.5 damage instead of x2.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_nightstalker.de: At night, gain Speed I and Strength I.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_tendril_reach.d: Umbral Grasp reaches 9 blocks and stuns for 3 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_eclipse_skin.de: +2 armor. Take 15% less damage while in darkness.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_dusk_dweller.de: Light-Bane no longer affects you, and bright light no longer drains Umbra.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_soul_siphon.des: Umbral Grasp heals you half a heart per enemy caught.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_shadow_clone.de: When a blow drops you below 40% health, instantly Shadow Meld for 3 seconds (90s cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.shade_phantom_blade.d: Melee hits against Blinded or Stunned targets deal +30% damage.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_lord_of_night.d: +2 max hearts. Shadow Meld's cooldown is halved, and you regenerate half a heart per second while melded.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_void_shroud.des: You are permanently invisible in deep darkness — but you take 50% more damage in sunlight.
abyssorigins.spec.occultist.name: Occultist
abyssorigins.spec.occultist.description: A practitioner of forbidden arts who sees beyond the veil. Reveals the hidden — even the invisible — curses foes and feeds on their essence.
abyssorigins.spec.warrior.name: Warrior
abyssorigins.spec.warrior.description: A frontline brawler who grows deadlier with every swing. Chain hits to build Momentum, then cash it in for sustain, executions or broken armor.
abyssorigins.spec.assassin.name: Assassin
abyssorigins.spec.assassin.description: A killer who strikes from where no one is looking. Backstabs, venom, and a talent for vanishing when the fight turns.
abyssorigins.spec.guardian.name: Guardian
abyssorigins.spec.guardian.description: An oath-bound wall between the Abyss and those behind you. Stuns, taunts, shields allies and takes their pain as your own.
abyssorigins.spec.ranger.name: Ranger
abyssorigins.spec.ranger.description: A hunter of the wild places at the Abyss's edge. Marks prey, rains arrows and never stays where the enemy expects.
abyssorigins.resonance.occultist_voidbor: Occult Vision reaches 24 blocks farther, and Hexbolt Sunders its target.
abyssorigins.resonance.warrior_demon.des: Hits at full Momentum stoke 3 Wrath, and Whirlwind sets enemies ablaze.
abyssorigins.resonance.warrior_human.des: Momentum takes twice as long to decay.
abyssorigins.resonance.assassin_shade.de: Strikes that break Shadow Meld always count as backstabs.
abyssorigins.resonance.guardian_seraph.d: Aegis restores 10 Radiance and scorches undead inside the dome.
abyssorigins.resonance.guardian_human.de: Bulwark's Resistance lasts twice as long.
abyssorigins.resonance.ranger_seraph.des: Projectiles deal +20% damage to undead and set them ablaze.

abyssorigins.skill.occultist.blood_ritua: Ritual power bleeds into your origin: origin ability cooldowns -10%.
abyssorigins.skill.occultist.phantom_ste: +8% movement speed. Activating Occult Vision grants 3 seconds of Invisibility.
abyssorigins.skill.occultist.dark_covena: +3 max hearts, +2 armor. Soul Drain heals 10% instead of 5%.
abyssorigins.skill.occultist.umbral_form: +15% damage. After using any ability, you briefly phase out of the world (Resistance IV for 1.5s).
abyssorigins.skill.occultist.ascended_oc: Occult Vision lasts until you dismiss it and also reveals hostile creatures. Hexbolt's cooldown is halved.
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_battle_trance: War Cry lasts 12 seconds and also grants Speed I.
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_cyclone.name: Cyclone
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_cyclone.desc: Whirlwind reaches 5 blocks and causes Bleeding.
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_bloodrage.des: Below 40% health, melee hits heal you for 15% of the damage dealt.
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_shieldbreaker: Hits at full Momentum Sunder the target (-2 armor) for 4 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_juggernaut.de: War Cry also grants Absorption II and immunity to knockback.
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_relentless.de: Every kill reduces Whirlwind's cooldown by 6 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_warlord.name: Warlord
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_warlord.desc: +2 armor toughness. War Cry's cooldown is halved, and Momentum never decays while it is active.
abyssorigins.skill.assassin_fleet.name: Fleet

abyssorigins.skill.assassin_vanish.name: Vanish
abyssorigins.skill.assassin_hemorrhage.d: Venom Edge's Bleeding is level II and lasts twice as long.
abyssorigins.skill.assassin_mark_for_dea: Shadowstep Hexes the target for 6s and outlines it — for your eyes only.
abyssorigins.skill.assassin_evasion.name: Evasion
abyssorigins.skill.assassin_evasion.desc: 15% chance to evade attacks from creatures.
abyssorigins.skill.assassin_smoke_bomb.d: When a blow drops you below 30% health, blind enemies within 4 blocks and vanish with Invisibility and Speed II (60s cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.assassin_deathmark.de: Backstabs against targets below 25% health deal triple damage. Shadowstep's cooldown is halved.
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_vigor.name: Vigor
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_concussive.d: Shield Bash deals 8 damage and stuns for 2.5 seconds.
Blocking a melee attack with a shield deals 3 damage to the attacker and Weakens it.
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_rally.name: Rally
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_rally.desc: Aegis heals allies inside it half a heart every second.
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_bastion.name: Bastion
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_bastion.desc: While sneaking and standing still, gain Resistance II.
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_provoke.name: Provoke
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_provoke.desc: Shield Bash taunts the creatures it hits, and Aegis covers 9 blocks.
+2 armor toughness. Aegis lasts 9 seconds and makes you immune to knockback.
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_martyr.name: Martyr
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_martyr.desc: 30% of the damage dealt to players within 8 blocks of you is taken by you instead.
Once every 4 minutes, when you or a player within 8 blocks would die, prevent it: they rise at 30% health, Sanctified II.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_eagle_eye.name: Eagle Eye
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_eagle_eye.desc: Steady Aim grants +25% projectile damage instead of +15%.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_fleetfoot.name: Fleetfoot
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_fleetfoot.desc: +8% speed. Projectile kills grant Speed I for 3 seconds.
Hunter's Mark lasts 20 seconds, and marked prey takes +15% damage from every source.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_survivalist.de: +1 max heart. When struck in melee, leap away from the attacker (5s cooldown).
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_broadhead.name: Broadhead
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_broadhead.desc: Volley arrows hit twice as hard and cause Bleeding.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_quarry.name: Quarry
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_quarry.desc: Killing marked prey resets Hunter's Mark and heals 2 hearts.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_trapper.name: Trapper
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_trapper.desc: Volley arrows inflict Slowness II for 3 seconds.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_storm_of_arrow: Volley looses a second wave one second later.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_heartseeker.de: Fully drawn (critical) arrows deal +50% damage to marked prey.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_apex_hunter.de: +20% projectile damage. Hunter's Mark spreads to every enemy within 5 blocks of the target.
abyssorigins.weapon.oathkeeper.power.des: Raise a 1.5s parry. The next blow against you is negated and the attacker is struck for 8 damage and Weakened.
abyssorigins.weapon.oathkeeper.passive.d: +25% damage against creatures with more max health than you.
abyssorigins.weapon.sanguine_scythe.powe: A wide sweep in front of you: 7 damage and Bleeding II to every enemy; each one feeds you 4 Blood and half a heart.
abyssorigins.weapon.sanguine_scythe.pass: Melee hits heal 15% of the damage, restore 2 Blood and cause Bleeding. +1 reach.
abyssorigins.weapon.hellbrand_cleaver.po: Spend 20 Wrath to erupt the ground: 8 damage to enemies within 4.5 blocks, setting them ablaze and launching them.
abyssorigins.weapon.hellbrand_cleaver.pa: Melee hits ignite the target and stoke 4 extra Wrath.
abyssorigins.weapon.dawnspear.power.desc: Fire a 16-block line of light: 8 damage to every enemy it pierces (12 to undead).
abyssorigins.weapon.dawnspear.passive.de: +40% damage to undead and sets them ablaze; hits gather 2 Radiance. +1.5 reach.
Collapse space in front of you: enemies within 7 blocks are dragged in, take 5 damage, and are Slowed and Sundered.
abyssorigins.weapon.event_horizon.passiv: Melee hits Sunder the target, stacking up to level III.
abyssorigins.weapon.shadowfang.power.des: Dash up to 7 blocks through the shadows and vanish for 3s. Your next strike deals +80% damage.
abyssorigins.weapon.shadowfang.passive.d: Strikes from behind or while invisible deal +80% damage; every hit gathers 3 Umbra. Very fast.
abyssorigins.armor_set.vanguard.bonus.de: Below half health you gain Resistance I.
abyssorigins.armor_set.nocturne.bonus.de: Sunlight burns you for half damage, and melee hits heal 10% of the damage dealt.
abyssorigins.armor_set.infernal.bonus.de: Gain 50% more Wrath, and creatures that strike you in melee catch fire.
abyssorigins.armor_set.choir.bonus.desc: Radiance gathers 50% faster and Earthbound Burden no longer weakens you.
abyssorigins.armor_set.abyssal.bonus.des: Hollow Form is negated (full healing) and Void Essence flows 0.5/s faster.
abyssorigins.armor_set.duskweave.bonus.d: Sneaking in darkness makes you invisible, and Umbra gathers 50% faster.

abyssorigins.message.vampire_food_refuse: Mortal food turns to ash in your mouth. You need blood.
abyssorigins.origin.eminence.name: The Eminence
abyssorigins.origin.eminence.description: The hidden sovereign of every bloodline. Blood, flame, light, void and shadow all answer to the crown: the Eminence holds every origin's skills and powers, binds any five of them to its sovereign keys, and rules the others with Presence, Royal Decree and Usurp.
abyssorigins.origin.eminence.trait.1: Holds every origin skill; binds any five powers
abyssorigins.origin.eminence.trait.3: Every relic answers to the crown
abyssorigins.origin.eminence.trait.4: Cannot follow a single path: no skill tree of its own
abyssorigins.passive.eminence_crown.name: Crown of All Bloodlines
abyssorigins.passive.eminence_crown.desc: Every origin's passive powers and skill-tree mechanics are yours. Bind any five powers, your own or any origin's, in the Sovereign Codex (O).
abyssorigins.passive.eminence_sovereign_: A body fit for the crown: 22.5 hearts, +8 armor, +4 toughness, 40% knockback resistance, +30% damage (+2 base), +15% attack speed, +10% speed, and every blow you take is 20% lighter. Water, sunlight, the deep earth and hunger hold no sway over you. You keep the mortal's regeneration and resilience, the vampire's night sight and speed, and wield every origin's relic.
abyssorigins.passive.eminence_unbowed.de: No crown kneels: you cannot be awed, made to kneel, sealed or stunned.
abyssorigins.ability.eminence_presence.d: The ground quakes as your majesty falls on every player within 25 blocks. Each must Kneel (frozen and trembling for 20s) or Resist with a skill check: three successes break free, failure tears away half their health and leaves them kneeling for 40s.
abyssorigins.ability.eminence_royal_decr: Seal the powers of every enemy player within 12 blocks for 10s. Beasts are stunned, weakened and forget their prey.
abyssorigins.ability.eminence_usurp.name: Usurp
abyssorigins.ability.eminence_usurp.desc: Seize the target you look at (16 blocks): steal every blessing on them and up to 30 of their origin's power as Dominion, dealing 4 damage and healing you for 4.
abyssorigins.presence.broken: Your will shatters before %s. You fall to your knees. (%ss)
gui.abyssorigins.presence.title: %s commands you to kneel
gui.abyssorigins.presence.body: Kneel, and be held trembling for 20 seconds. Resist, and prove your will in three trials. Fail, and lose half your life and 40 seconds on your knees.
gui.abyssorigins.resist.title: RESIST THE PRESENCE
gui.abyssorigins.resist.hint: Press SPACE or click as the needle crosses the gold

abyssorigins.skill.human_apex_legacy.des: Generations of survivors stand behind you. +4 max health, +1 armor toughness.
No bloodline limits what a mortal may become. +5% speed, +1 attack damage.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_apex_elder_blood: Your blood is older than kingdoms. +4 max health, +1 attack damage.
abyssorigins.skill.vamp_apex_night_sover: The night bends around your hunt. +8% attack speed, +4% speed.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_apex_hell_sover: Lesser fiends kneel to your fury. +2 attack damage.
abyssorigins.skill.demon_apex_brimstone_: A heart of molten stone beats in your chest. +3 armor, +2 max health.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_apex_choir.des: The heavenly host sings you back from every wound. +4 max health.
abyssorigins.skill.seraph_apex_radiant_h: A crown of light turns blows aside. +2 armor toughness, +4% speed.
abyssorigins.skill.void_apex_event_horiz: Space folds ahead of your every step. +8% speed.
abyssorigins.skill.void_apex_null_body.d: There is less of you to strike. +3 armor, +15% knockback resistance.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_apex_umbral_cro: Every shadow is yours to command. +1.5 attack damage.
abyssorigins.skill.shade_apex_unseen.des: You were never there at all. +8% speed.
abyssorigins.skill.warrior_apex_titan.de: Built to stand where armies break. +6 max health.
Every swing lands like a verdict. +2 attack damage.
abyssorigins.skill.assassin_apex_killing: Death, perfected into a craft. +1.5 attack damage.
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_apex_living_: You are the wall. +3 armor, +2 armor toughness.
abyssorigins.skill.guardian_apex_undying: Your vow outlasts your wounds. +6 max health.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_apex_windrunne: The wilds part before you. +10% speed.
abyssorigins.skill.ranger_apex_wild_hear: Rooted like the old trees. +4 max health, +10% knockback resistance.
abyssorigins.skill.occ_apex_veilwalker.d: You walk half a step outside the world. +8% speed.
abyssorigins.skill.occ_apex_forbidden_lo: What you have read cannot be unread. +4 max health, +1 armor.

abyssorigins.ability.hidden_portal.name: Portal
abyssorigins.ability.hidden_portal.desc: Aim at a spot within 128 blocks and use to place the first endpoint, then aim at a second spot within 128 blocks and use again to link them. For 300 seconds any player can step through either end to reach the other — even into your pocket dimension. Sneak + use cancels a placed endpoint; use while the portal is open closes it.
abyssorigins.ability.hidden_pocket.name: Pocket Dimension
abyssorigins.ability.hidden_pocket.desc: Distort through space into your own private dimension: an endless night over the void, with a platform to stand on. Only you are taken. Use again to return to where you left from.
abyssorigins.ability.hidden_punish.name: Punish Dimension
abyssorigins.ability.hidden_punish.desc: Aim at a player to drag them into the punishment realm, crucified and unable to move for 60 seconds. While it lasts, use again to step in and watch them (or strike), and again to leave.
abyssorigins.message.realm_missing: That dimension is missing — is the mod's data pack disabled?
abyssorigins.message.portal_realm: Portals can't open in this realm.
abyssorigins.message.pocket_entered: You slip into your pocket dimension.
abyssorigins.message.pocket_blocked: There is no way out of here.

abyssorigins.message.crucified: You are bound and can do nothing.
